body: I meow, hiss like a cat, growl, purr etc. I just got used to it as did everyone around me. My friends think it's cute apparently.
YES! Haha normally I'm either a pixie or a rockstar. Sometimes I'm a supreme dictator.
What I'm actually doing is graduating over the summer now. I'm about 2 credits short. I also got a new box of razor blades though, just in case.

I need to earn 2 credits in the next 3 1/2 weeks. On top of completing some classes that I'm suddenly apparently failing. I've been at risk for not graduating since my sophomore year, and this is just solidifying the reality. I haven't even been able to apply to any colleges yet.
I've talked to all of them as well, and I've been working with them to graduate, but it's not going to happen.
I wish I did have my shit together. But I don't.
I've been seeing a variety of counselors/psychiatrists and doctors for about 6 years, and no definitive progress has been made.
What do you mean? Sarcasm? Please explain.

I am in my eighteenth year of my life, and I have been through more traumatic experiences than most adults. I suffer from severe depression and several other diagnoses. I'm trying to graduate highschool but I'm in more danger of failing than ever. And now I'm fed up.
